from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

import yaml


ROOT = pathlib.Path("/private/var/folders/gj/bxx0438j003b20kn5b6s7bsh0000gn/T/spec-kitty-20260810-011637-xWqxfc/spec-kitty/.worktrees/assertive-test-suite-sanitation-01KZME3P-lane-k")
BASE = "28ae75ea998c898aba57364db7a06d2088bd2af2"
REL = pathlib.Path("docs/reports/test-sanitation/assertive-test-suite-sanitation-01KZME3P")
LEDGER_PATH = ROOT / REL / "dispositions/WP11.yaml"
RESULTS_PATH = ROOT / REL / "raw/wp11-results.json"
CENSUS_PATH = pathlib.Path("/private/var/folders/gj/bxx0438j003b20kn5b6s7bsh0000gn/T/spec-kitty-20260810-011637-xWqxfc/spec-kitty/.worktrees/assertive-test-suite-sanitation-01KZME3P-lane-a") / REL / "raw/base-census.json"


def functions(source: str, path: str) -> set[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    found: set[str] = set()

    def visit(body: list[ast.stmt], owners: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> None:
        for node in body:
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                visit(node.body, (*owners, node.name))
            elif isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name.startswith("test"):
                found.add(f"{path}::{'.'.join((*owners, node.name))}")

    visit(tree.body)
    return found


changed = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "diff", "--name-only", BASE, "--", "tests/specify_cli", "tests/test_dashboard"],
    cwd=ROOT,
    text=True,
).splitlines()
base_functions: set[str] = set()
head_functions: set[str] = set()
for path in changed:
    try:
        frozen = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{path}"], cwd=ROOT, text=True)
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        frozen = ""
    current_path = ROOT / path
    current = current_path.read_text() if current_path.exists() else ""
    if frozen:
        base_functions |= functions(frozen, path)
    if current:
        head_functions |= functions(current, path)

removed = base_functions - head_functions
base_canonical_dashboard: set[str] = set()
for path in (
    "tests/specify_cli/dashboard/test_glossary_handler.py",
    "tests/specify_cli/dashboard/test_lint_tile_handler.py",
):
    source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{path}"], cwd=ROOT, text=True)
    base_canonical_dashboard |= functions(source, path)
migrations = {
    member
    for member in removed
    if member.startswith("tests/test_dashboard/")
    and (canonical := member.replace("tests/test_dashboard/", "tests/specify_cli/dashboard/", 1)) in head_functions
    and canonical not in base_canonical_dashboard
}
true_deletions = removed - migrations

ledger = yaml.safe_load(LEDGER_PATH.read_text())
rows = ledger["dispositions"]
prior_rows = [row for row in rows if not str(row["candidate"]["id"]).startswith("WP11-C3-")]
cycle3_rows = [row for row in rows if str(row["candidate"]["id"]).startswith("WP11-C3-")]
prior_terminal = {member for row in prior_rows for member in row["candidate"].get("deleted_members", [])}
cycle3_terminal = {member for row in cycle3_rows for member in row["candidate"].get("deleted_members", [])}
all_terminal = prior_terminal | cycle3_terminal
assert len(removed) == 143
assert len(migrations) == 11
assert len(true_deletions) == 132
assert len(prior_terminal) == 89
assert len(cycle3_rows) == len(cycle3_terminal) == 43
assert not (prior_terminal & cycle3_terminal)
assert true_deletions == all_terminal

census = json.loads(CENSUS_PATH.read_text())
units = {unit["id"]: unit for unit in census["source_units"]}
node_count = sum(len(units[member]["node_refs"]) for member in all_terminal)
assert node_count == 477

results = json.loads(RESULTS_PATH.read_text())
coverage = results["terminal_coverage"]
assert set(coverage["dashboard_migrations"]) == migrations
assert set(coverage["true_deleted_source_functions"]) == true_deletions
assert set(coverage["prior_terminal_deletions"]) == prior_terminal
assert set(coverage["cycle3_terminal_deletions"]) == cycle3_terminal
assert set(coverage["all_terminal_deletions"]) == all_terminal
assert coverage["set_equality"]["holds"] is True
assert coverage["function_to_node_reconciliation"]["holds"] is True
assert coverage["function_to_node_reconciliation"]["removed_pytest_nodes"] == node_count

normalized = results["reconciliation"]["normalized"]
updates = set(coverage["normalized_split_reconciliations"])
updated_records = [record for record in normalized if record["fingerprint"] in updates]
assert len(updated_records) == len(updates) == 6
formerly_split = set(coverage["formerly_split_deleted_members"])
assert len(formerly_split) == 10
assert all(record["terminal_disposition"] != "SPLIT_NON_EQUIVALENT" for record in updated_records)
assert formerly_split <= all_terminal
assert formerly_split == {
    member
    for record in updated_records
    for member in record.get("terminal_mapping", {})
}

# Every final-cycle terminal row has either a collected survivor campaign or the bounded no-survivor proof.
for row in cycle3_rows:
    candidate = row["candidate"]
    assert len(candidate["members"]) == len(candidate["deleted_members"]) == 1
    replacements = candidate["replacement_survivors"]
    if replacements:
        assert row["survivor"] == replacements[0]
        assert set(candidate["survivor_collection"]) == set(replacements)
        assert all(candidate["survivor_collection"][item] for item in replacements)
        assert row["evidence"]["causal_probe"]["intended_oracle_failed"] is True
    else:
        assert row["survivor"] is None
        assert row["evidence"]["no_survivor_proof"]["classification"] == "no-survivor"

# Fail closed on artifact referential integrity.
results_hash = hashlib.sha256(RESULTS_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert all(row["evidence"]["receipt_sha256"] == results_hash for row in rows)

# The retained VCS truth-table function must explicitly assert both missing partitions without adding pytest nodes.
vcs_path = ROOT / "tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/test_implement_vcs_lock_claim.py"
tree = ast.parse(vcs_path.read_text())
vcs_function = next(
    node for node in tree.body
    if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
    and node.name == "test_is_vcs_lock_only_meta_diff_truth_table"
)
assertions = {ast.unparse(node.test) for node in ast.walk(vcs_function) if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)}
assert "_is_vcs_lock_only_meta_diff(None, {}) is False" in assertions
assert "_is_vcs_lock_only_meta_diff({}, {}) is False" in assertions
vcs_row = next(row for row in rows if row["candidate"]["id"] == "WP11-08faab8d1a9c")
repair = vcs_row["candidate"]["input_partition_repair"]
assert repair["added_to_survivor"] == ["(None, {}) -> False", "({}, {}) -> False"]
assert len(repair["baseline_cases"]) == len(repair["faulted_cases"]) == 8

print(json.dumps({
    "status": "closed",
    "removed_functions": len(removed),
    "dashboard_migrations": len(migrations),
    "true_deletions": len(true_deletions),
    "prior_terminal": len(prior_terminal),
    "cycle3_terminal": len(cycle3_terminal),
    "terminal_total": len(all_terminal),
    "removed_nodes": node_count,
    "normalized_records_reconciled": len(updated_records),
    "formerly_split_deleted_members": len(formerly_split),
    "vcs_empty_partitions": repair["added_to_survivor"],
}, sort_keys=True))
